text:
ria_cs: Heads-up — customer on Dedicated reported TypeScript compile failures from our code-assist model after yesterday's v2 rollout. They say snippets that previously compiled now error. Repro + payload below. Tagging eng, P1 for now.

ria_cs: Payload they sent (trimmed):
```json
{
  "model": "gen-assist-1.3.0",
  "prompt": "Generate a TypeScript helper that exports a function to validate user input"
}
```

ria_cs: Observed output from model (what they tried to compile):
```ts
interface User { name: string; email: string }
export function validate(u: User) {
  if(!u.email) return false
}
// missing export default / missing return type, breaks downstream TS assumptions
```

dan_eng: I'm on it. Can you paste the exact model response and the tsc error log? Also which region/dedicated pool? @maria_se fyi.

ria_cs: tsc error (from customer): "TS2365: A function whose declared type is 'boolean' must return a value in all code paths." They are on eu-west-1 dedicated pool. Full model response attached above.

maria_se: Quick thought — we shipped a newline/whitespace normalization and a tiny change to how we render trailing semicolons in the latest variant. Could be dropping `return true` or moving comments. Will compare v1.2.8 -> v1.3.0 output diffs.

tj_oncall: @deploy-bot can you show the rollout note for gen-assist-1.3.0?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed at 2025-07-18T03:22:10Z for gen-assist-1.3.0 (variant: v2). Changes: adjusted sampling temperature distribution, normalized newlines, and updated output post-processing to trim trailing whitespace.

dan_eng: That newline/trimming change could strip intentionally inserted "return true;" if our prompt templates relied on a dangling line. Reproducing locally now with the exact request. If I can reproduce, recommend rollback to gen-assist-1.2.8 for dedicated clusters.

maria_se: Quick diff I ran (v1.2.8 output vs v1.3.0):
```diff
- export default function validate(u: User): boolean {
-   if(!u.email) return false;
-   return true;
- }
+ export function validate(u: User) {
+   if(!u.email) return false
+ }
```
Looks like semicolons and final return are missing, plus default export removed in some cases. That's breaking type checks.

ria_cs: Customer reports that pinning model to gen-assist-1.2.8 fixed their CI immediately. They asked for rollback for the shared dedicated pool.

sophie_prod: Need impact numbers before blanket rollback. How many tenants hit this? Can we scope to affected customers/pools? Also need approval from oncall for emergency rollback.

ria_cs: So far 3 customers in eu-west-1 reported: one P1 (this thread), two P2s with similar compile failures. Ticket IDs: CS-8201 (P1), CS-8207, CS-8210.

dan_eng: I'll open an internal issue with reproducible tests and run our unit/regression suite. If confirmed, I'll request rollback. @tj_oncall please confirm if you can approve immediate rollback for the dedicated eu-west-1 pools.

tj_oncall: Approved. Rollback ok for impacted dedicated pools; confirm timeframe and update customers when done.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: change-id=rb-20250718-003; target: gen-assist-1.2.8 on dedicated eu-west-1 pools. Estimated time: ~4m.

ria_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll update CS-8201 and mark P1 as mitigated once rollback completes. Please keep notes for postmortem; we should include prompt-suite regression tests. :thumbsup:

dan_eng: Will dump diffs, add test cases to the eval harness, and follow up with root cause. Likely a post-processing regression in the v2 variant.

maria_se: Also checking our tokenization/serialization tests — will share quick blamestorm in the issue.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 2025-07-18T03:27:30Z. gen-assist-1.2.8 restored on dedicated eu-west-1.

ria_cs: Confirmed with customer — build green after rollback. Closing P1 interim. I'll keep the thread open until postmortem links are added.

sophie_prod: Good work. Postmortem request: include rollout checklist gap and a mitigation path (canary guardrails).

dan_eng: Roger. Adding tests and PR for guarded output-formatting checks.

ria_cs: I'll update tickets and share an email template for affected customers. Thanks all!
